name: Legion Strength makes Skulltaker ignore 25% of the target's Armor (#1149)
contract: Legion Strength 572370 reads 'Your Skulltaker now ignores $s1% of the target's Armor.' Effect 0 is native aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 13 (SPELLMOD_IGNORE_ARMOR), EffectBasePoints -26 with DieSides 1 -> resolved -25 (matching the installed moa_description 'ignores -25% of the target's Armor', not the raw -26 BasePoints), classmask [0, 1, 0] (spell_family_id 23), all verified directly via csv.DictReader against /home/fab/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/ascension-data/tables/spell.csv.gz. That classmask (word1 bit0) matches Skulltaker's own family flags (spells 800168/802416-802421/803899/803900, family_flags word1 bit0 = 4294967296 combined-low encoding) -- the level-60 Knight of Xoroth owns rank 803900 (AscensionSpellProgressionData.h:723). Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage (Unit.cpp:2259) is the native consumer: modOwner->ApplySpellMod(spellInfo->Id, SPELLMOD_IGNORE_ARMOR, armor) runs before mitigation whenever the attacker has a spell-mod owner, a real wired consumer, not a stub. This is the same native SPELLMOD_IGNORE_ARMOR op already exercised structurally elsewhere in this repo (op13), distinct from the custom SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT (338) used by Absolutism.
